messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — Acme SI needs to finish credentialing + a pen-test witness window before we can greenlight the marketplace listing. Who should own the artifact package and presigned URL flow?

sam (security): We own redaction + presign generation, but we need the SI to share SOC2 scope, contact for the pen vendor, and a signed NDA before any artifact access. @maria can you confirm the SI point of contact?

devon (solutions): Also need to know whether Acme will include firmware blobs in the bundle or if those are handled via a separate HSM attestation package. That changes storage and redaction rules.

ellie (compliance): For marketplace compliance we need: SOC2 Type II (last 12 months), pen-test report with CVEs triage, network diagram, data-flow, and HSM/KMS attestation if keys are involved. Prefer single ZIP + manifest.json with checksums.

maria (partnerships): POC is jlee@acme-sis.com. ETA for docs is next Tue per them. Proposed pen window Apr 10-17, witness day Apr 12. Any blockers?

sam (security): NDA required before they upload. Once NDA is in place, we'll provision a restricted S3 path and presigns with 72h TTL. I'll own redaction requests.

devon (solutions): I'll provision the storage and a short-lived role. Plan: bucket = marketplace-evidence/acme-1729001234, prefix = /raw, presign command we use: ```aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/acme-1729001234/raw/acme_pen.zip --expires-in 259200```

ellie (compliance): Please include manifest fields: vendor_name, artifact_type, sha256, scope_period, contact_email, nda_signed=true. We'll require attestations for any firmware blobs.

maria (partnerships): I'll send NDA link and intro to jlee now. @devon can you create bucket and IAM by EOD so they can upload next week?

devon (solutions): On it — creating bucket and a least-privilege role. I'll post IAM policy snippet in this thread when done.

sam (security): Once uploaded I'll start redaction pass. Reminder: redact internal IPs and customer-identifiable logs before we publish anything external.

deploy-bot: scheduled marketplace-listing/dry-run for acme-sis at 2024-04-20T15:00:00Z (automated)

maria (partnerships): Thanks team — I'll draft announcement cadence (internal embargo -> partner preview -> public) and assign owners. Will follow up with calendar invites. :thumbsup:

devon (solutions): IAM policy snippet (preview): ```{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::marketplace-evidence/acme-1729001234/*"}, {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:DeleteObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::marketplace-evidence/acme-1729001234/*"} ]}```

sam (security): Perfect — once the bucket exists ping me and I'll coordinate the redaction + witness scheduling with the pen vendor.

maria (partnerships): Great. Closing loop here — I'll post NDA + contact intro in 5.
